router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED gauntlet gauntlet-macos tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.gauntlet:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'gauntlet')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: lobo
          fetch-depth: 0   # the stamp step holds the channel against the tags (ws19)

      - name: read toolchain pins
        id: pins
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: |
          rev() { awk -v s="[$1]" '$0==s{f=1} f&&/^rev = /{gsub(/"/,"",$3); print $3; exit}' wolf-toolchain.toml; }
          echo "wolf=$(rev wolf)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "lupin=$(rev lupin)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "std=$(rev std)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # The sibling repos are private; the default token cannot read
      # them (the wolf-book lesson), so WOLF_CI_TOKEN is how the org
      # grants it. **ws37: absence is FAILURE.** Until this commit the
      # step answered `toolchain=none` and exited 0 when the secret was
      # absent, and every step below was guarded on `== 'full'` — so
      # this job reported SUCCESS in nine seconds having built nothing
      # and run no gauntlet (the planted run 35957256102: twelve of
      # sixteen steps skipped, `lobo-gauntlet` among them). lobo's only
      # automated gate could be switched off by a secret lapsing, with
      # no signal anywhere. The acquisition is one composite action now
      # (tl10's shape in wolf-lsp#28), it keeps git's stderr, and it
      # reds the job when it cannot acquire.
      - name: acquire the pinned toolchain
        id: acquire
        uses: ./lobo/.github/actions/acquire-toolchain
        with:
          # Seen red before it was trusted: the same job with this name
          # misspelled reds at the acquisition with the reason in its
          # annotation (run 35957399446), where the old step reported
          # success in nine seconds (run 35957256102).
          token: ${{ secrets.WOLF_CI_TOKEN }}
          path: lobo

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: |
            wolf-lang
            wolf-interp

      - name: build pinned wolf (release) + runtime staticlib
        shell: bash
        working-directory: wolf-lang
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The stamp is used VERBATIM in `--version`, and
          # wolf-toolchain.toml's version_line names the SHORT rev
          # (the D57 shape sc30 recorded), so truncate here rather
          # than letting the identity check refuse a full-sha stamp.
          # ws13: when the pinned rev IS a release tag (v0.2.2 was the
          # first), the D57 release stamp rides along — xtask's own
          # rule, granted only when that exact tag points at HEAD —
          # so `--version` claims the bare version the pin file names.
          # A trunk pin has no such tag and stays `+dev.<short>`.
          TAG="$(git tag --points-at HEAD | grep '^v[0-9]' | head -1 || true)"
          if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then export WOLF_RELEASE="$TAG"; fi
          WOLF_COMMIT="$(echo "${{ steps.pins.outputs.wolf }}" | cut -c1-7)" \
            cargo build --release -p wolf_driver -p wolf_rt

      - name: build pinned lupin (release)
        shell: bash
        working-directory: wolf-interp
        run: cargo build --release --bin lupin

      # The wolf pin is built with the D57 dev stamp: WOLF_COMMIT is
      # what makes `--version` claim the rev, and lib-toolchain.sh
      # refuses the unstamped `+dev.unknown` a plain cargo build emits.
      - name: stage .wolf-bin
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p lobo/.wolf-bin
          cp wolf-lang/target/release/wolf wolf-lang/target/release/libwolf_rt.a lobo/.wolf-bin/
          cp wolf-interp/target/release/lupin lobo/.wolf-bin/
          # [std] is a SOURCE TREE, not a binary: staged by the
          # documented one-time action, identified by its STD-REV
          # marker (a tree has no --version).
          git -C wolf-std archive "${{ steps.pins.outputs.std }}" std | tar -x -C lobo/.wolf-bin/
          git -C wolf-std rev-parse "${{ steps.pins.outputs.std }}" > lobo/.wolf-bin/std/STD-REV

      # The differential oracle, cached on the pin file — a CI step is
      # not a build script in the D33 sense (the wsc00 closeout records
      # the interpretation). The build recipe is docs/DIFFERENTIAL.md's,
      # driven by the values in NGINX-PIN itself.
      - name: cache pinned nginx
        id: nginx-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: lobo/tests/differential/bin
          key: nginx-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('lobo/tests/differential/NGINX-PIN') }}

      - name: build pinned nginx (cache miss only)
        if: steps.nginx-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PIN="$PWD/tests/differential/NGINX-PIN"
          pin() { sed -n "s/^$1 = //p" "$PIN"; }
          mkdir -p /tmp/nginx-build && cd /tmp/nginx-build
          curl -sSLO "$(pin source)"
          echo "$(pin sha256)  $(pin tarball)" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf "$(pin tarball)"
          cd "nginx-$(pin version)"
          $(pin configure)
          make -j"$(nproc)"
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/lobo/tests/differential/bin"
          cp objs/nginx "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/lobo/tests/differential/bin/nginx"
          rm -rf /tmp/nginx-build

      # The rig's host tools beyond the toolchain (CONTRIBUTING.md's list):
      # POSIX sh, awk, jq, diff and a real OpenSSL 3.x for the TLS
      # steps, plus nc for the acme/proxy/metrics drives. ubuntu-latest
      # ships awk/jq/diff/openssl-3.x. Declare ApacheBench and Python
      # explicitly now that the relative proxy row runs in every gate.
      - name: host tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq netcat-openbsd apache2-utils python3
          openssl version

      - name: lobo-gauntlet
        if: inputs.parity != true && inputs.profile != true && inputs.syscalls != true
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: tools/lobo-gauntlet

      # ws22: the W8 bar on the one linux x86-64 the org has hands on.
      # docs/PARITY.md names this runner as a gating HOST and its noise
      # as the reason the statistic is a same-box ratio; a refused set
      # (load, the generator as ceiling, an unstable oracle) is a red
      # step with the reason in the log, never a vacuous green.
      # ws25 (lobo#6): a second tree, built beside this one, so the
      # parity set (and the profile leg) can read two lobos on ONE VM
      # against that VM's own nginx — the only linux delta the runner
      # can hold still. ws36 (lobo#20): the ref tree is built with the
      # toolchain ITS OWN pin file names, not this checkout's — ws25's
      # one symlinked .wolf-bin died on identity drift the moment the
      # ref sat on another [wolf] pin (run 34676503607), so a pin-bump
      # lane could not profile itself against the trunk it branched
      # from. tools/lobo-stage-ref keeps the one link when every pin
      # agrees; otherwise it builds the ref's own [wolf] and [lupin] at
      # their pinned revs from the clones this job already holds, with
      # the step above's D57 stamp, and archives the ref's own [std],
      # and the ref tree's lib-toolchain.sh still has the final word.
      # --from source, not the release archives the tool defaults to:
      # the org refuses WOLF_CI_TOKEN the REST API a release download
      # needs (a fine-grained token past 366 days; run 35030562781)
      # while git over HTTPS still serves it, and a source build is how
      # this job acquires its OWN toolchain, so both trees are built
      # alike. A dev-stamped ref pin builds the same way.
      - name: "build the ref tree (ws25; ws36 — its own pinned toolchain, lobo#20)"
        if: (inputs.parity == true || inputs.profile == true) && inputs.ref_tree != ''
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WOLF_CI_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git -C lobo worktree add ../lobo-ref "${{ inputs.ref_tree }}"
          ln -s "$PWD/lobo/tests/differential/bin" lobo-ref/tests/differential/bin
          WOLF_LANG_GIT="$PWD/wolf-lang" WOLF_INTERP_GIT="$PWD/wolf-interp" WOLF_STD_GIT="$PWD/wolf-std" \
            lobo/tools/lobo-stage-ref "$PWD/lobo-ref" --host x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --from source
          cd lobo-ref
          echo "ref tree: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) $(git log -1 --format=%s | cut -c1-90)"
          mkdir -p target
          # the ref tree builds as its OWN gauntlet did, flag for flag: a
          # tree from before ws52 passed WOLF_MIDEND=0 (wolf-lang#146)
          if grep -q 'WOLF_MIDEND=0 "$WOLF" build --release' tools/lobo-gauntlet; then export WOLF_MIDEND=0; else unset WOLF_MIDEND; fi
          sh -c '. tools/lib-toolchain.sh; "$WOLF" build --release ./src/main.lu -o target/lobo-release'
          ./target/lobo-release -v

      - name: lobo-parity (the W8 bar — a number, never a gate)
        if: inputs.parity == true
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        env:
          LOBO_REF: ${{ inputs.ref_tree != '' && format('{0}/lobo-ref/target/lobo-release', github.workspace) || '' }}
          LOBO_REF_NAME: ${{ inputs.ref_name }}
          LOBO_NAME: ${{ inputs.this_name }}
          LOBO_LISTEN_ARGS: ${{ inputs.listen_args }}
          LOBO_REF_LISTEN_ARGS: ${{ inputs.ref_listen_args }}
          PARITY_N: ${{ inputs.parity_n }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq apache2-utils
          mkdir -p target
          env -u WOLF_MIDEND sh -c '. tools/lib-toolchain.sh; "$WOLF" build --release ./src/main.lu -o target/lobo-release'
          # the bar's quiet-rig rule (load(1m) under 3.0) — the build
          # that just finished is the runner's own load; let it decay,
          # bounded, and let the tool refuse if it does not
          for i in $(seq 1 18); do
            l=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg); echo "load(1m) $l"
            awk -v l="$l" 'BEGIN { exit (l < 2.0) ? 0 : 1 }' && break
            sleep 10
          done
          nproc; uptime
          [ -z "$LOBO_REF" ] || echo "two trees: $LOBO_NAME = $PWD/target/lobo-release, $LOBO_REF_NAME = $LOBO_REF"
          # ws58: the bar's own arguments (pairs, seconds, connections)
          # with the gating cell's hands named when parity_n is given
          if [ -n "$PARITY_N" ]; then
            for n in $(echo "$PARITY_N" | tr ',' ' '); do
              echo "=== parity set at N=$n"
              tools/lobo-parity 5 5 32 "$n"
            done
          else
            tools/lobo-parity
          fi

      # ws25 (lobo#6): the profile leg. perf needs the kernel's own
      # linux-tools; the azure kernel's package is in the archive
      # under its exact release, and when it is not the tool SKIPS by
      # name (a skip is not a number). strace is the syscall counter.
      - name: "lobo-profile (ws25 — perf record + strace -c on one hand; ws27 both shapes; ws31 at N hands)"
        if: inputs.profile == true
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq apache2-utils strace > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq linux-tools-common "linux-tools-$(uname -r)" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
            || sudo apt-get install -y -qq linux-tools-common linux-tools-generic > /dev/null 2>&1 \
            || echo "::warning::no linux-tools package for $(uname -r); the profile leg will skip by name"
          if ! command -v perf > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            p=$(ls -d /usr/lib/linux-tools/*/perf 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
            [ -n "$p" ] && sudo ln -sf "$p" /usr/local/bin/perf
          fi
          perf --version || true
          sudo sysctl -w kernel.perf_event_paranoid=-1 kernel.kptr_restrict=0 > /dev/null || true
          mkdir -p target
          [ -x target/lobo-release ] || env -u WOLF_MIDEND sh -c '. tools/lib-toolchain.sh; "$WOLF" build --release ./src/main.lu -o target/lobo-release'
          nproc; uptime
          LOBO_LISTEN_ARGS="${{ inputs.listen_args }}" tools/lobo-profile target/lobo-release "${{ inputs.this_name }}" 8 "${{ inputs.profile_shape }}" "${{ inputs.profile_n }}" "${{ inputs.profile_hands }}"
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.ref_tree }}" ]; then
            LOBO_LISTEN_ARGS="${{ inputs.ref_listen_args }}" tools/lobo-profile "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/lobo-ref/target/lobo-release" "${{ inputs.ref_name }}" 8 "${{ inputs.profile_shape }}" "${{ inputs.profile_n }}" "${{ inputs.profile_hands }}"
          fi

      # ws27: the count leg. strace -c over every serving process of
      # BOTH servers for a whole drive, the calls column divided by the
      # requests the generators completed — a count is the one linux
      # number a shared VM holds still, and it is taken at the bar's
      # own cell (N=nproc, c=32) on both shapes. ws30 adds the IDLE
      # shape: the same processes, no drive, calls per SECOND — the
      # per-time rows (wolf-lang#302's futex) read with the clock as
      # the divisor, which is the only divisor they have.
      - name: "lobo-syscalls (ws27 — strace -c over both servers, calls per request, both shapes; ws30 — and per second at idle)"
        if: inputs.syscalls == true
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq apache2-utils strace > /dev/null
          mkdir -p target
          [ -x target/lobo-release ] || env -u WOLF_MIDEND sh -c '. tools/lib-toolchain.sh; "$WOLF" build --release ./src/main.lu -o target/lobo-release'
          nproc; uptime
          export LOBO_LISTEN_ARGS="${{ inputs.listen_args }}"
          tools/lobo-syscalls keepalive
          tools/lobo-syscalls close
          tools/lobo-syscalls idle

  # ws54 (lobo#52): the gauntlet on macOS arm64, the second host W8 and
  # the drop-in claim name. Until this job no CI ran the gauntlet off
  # linux, so the macOS red ws48 found by hand at confcheck (the `user`
  # refusal on a host with no /proc, since ws41) had never been a CI
  # red. Same pins, same build as the linux job (from source, the D57
  # stamp), the oracle built with Homebrew's openssl@3 per
  # docs/DIFFERENTIAL.md's macOS note; $OPENSSL_BIN names a real
  # OpenSSL 3 (macOS ships LibreSSL as `openssl`).
ci.yml.gauntlet-macos:
# The full tier's alone (and never a measurement's: ci/tiers.py).
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'gauntlet-macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: lobo
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: read toolchain pins
        id: pins
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: |
          rev() { awk -v s="[$1]" '$0==s{f=1} f&&/^rev = /{gsub(/"/,"",$3); print $3; exit}' wolf-toolchain.toml; }
          echo "wolf=$(rev wolf)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "lupin=$(rev lupin)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "std=$(rev std)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: acquire the pinned toolchain
        uses: ./lobo/.github/actions/acquire-toolchain
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.WOLF_CI_TOKEN }}
          path: lobo

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: |
            wolf-lang
            wolf-interp

      - name: build pinned wolf (release) + runtime staticlib
        shell: bash
        working-directory: wolf-lang
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="$(git tag --points-at HEAD | grep '^v[0-9]' | head -1 || true)"
          if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then export WOLF_RELEASE="$TAG"; fi
          WOLF_COMMIT="$(echo "${{ steps.pins.outputs.wolf }}" | cut -c1-7)" \
            cargo build --release -p wolf_driver -p wolf_rt

      - name: build pinned lupin (release)
        shell: bash
        working-directory: wolf-interp
        run: cargo build --release --bin lupin

      - name: stage .wolf-bin
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p lobo/.wolf-bin
          cp wolf-lang/target/release/wolf wolf-lang/target/release/libwolf_rt.a lobo/.wolf-bin/
          [ -f wolf-lang/target/release/wolf-cimport-worker ] && cp wolf-lang/target/release/wolf-cimport-worker lobo/.wolf-bin/ || true
          cp wolf-interp/target/release/lupin lobo/.wolf-bin/
          git -C wolf-std archive "${{ steps.pins.outputs.std }}" std | tar -x -C lobo/.wolf-bin/
          git -C wolf-std rev-parse "${{ steps.pins.outputs.std }}" > lobo/.wolf-bin/std/STD-REV

      - name: cache pinned nginx
        id: nginx-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: lobo/tests/differential/bin
          key: nginx-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('lobo/tests/differential/NGINX-PIN') }}

      - name: build pinned nginx (cache miss only)
        if: steps.nginx-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PIN="$PWD/tests/differential/NGINX-PIN"
          pin() { sed -n "s/^$1 = //p" "$PIN"; }
          OSSL="$(brew --prefix openssl@3)"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/nginx-build" && cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/nginx-build"
          curl -sSLO "$(pin source)"
          echo "$(pin sha256)  $(pin tarball)" | shasum -a 256 -c -
          tar xzf "$(pin tarball)"
          cd "nginx-$(pin version)"
          $(pin configure) --with-cc-opt="-I$OSSL/include" --with-ld-opt="-L$OSSL/lib"
          make -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)"
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/lobo/tests/differential/bin"
          cp objs/nginx "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/lobo/tests/differential/bin/nginx"

      - name: host tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          command -v gtar > /dev/null || brew install gnu-tar
          command -v ab > /dev/null
          command -v python3 > /dev/null
          # the rig runs every lane under GNU `timeout -k` (tools/lobo-corpus,
          # ws25's process hygiene); macOS has none — the first run of this
          # job (37779996097) red at corpus on `timeout: command not found`
          brew list coreutils > /dev/null 2>&1 || brew install coreutils
          echo "$(brew --prefix coreutils)/libexec/gnubin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          echo "OPENSSL_BIN=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/bin/openssl" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/bin/openssl" version
          gtar --version | head -1; jq --version; command -v nc

      - name: lobo-gauntlet
        shell: bash
        working-directory: lobo
        run: tools/lobo-gauntlet

  # The run's verdict, and its name: `tier full`, `tier pr` or `tier noop`.
  # It needs every job, runs unless the run was cancelled, and fails unless
  # the plan succeeded, the jobs it chose are the tier's, every
  # chosen job succeeded and every other job was skipped (ci/tiers.py
  # verdict). lane-audit.sh reads this job's name and conclusion.
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - gauntlet
      - gauntlet-macos
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: every chosen job succeeded, every other was skipped
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict

  # A red nightly opens an issue (ruling #92): a scheduled run has no lane
  # watching it, so the red has to come and find one. One open issue per
  # workflow, its title the dedupe key; a further red night comments on it
  # (ci/nightly-red.sh, tested by ci/tiers-test.py T8). Never on a pull
  # request, a push or a dispatch: those reds have a lane attached already.
ci.yml.nightly-red:
name: nightly red, an issue
    needs: tier
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: open or update the nightly-red issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: ci/nightly-red.sh
